answer_summary: M = 1-methyl-4-tert-butylbenzene (para, thermodynamic FC product with four proton types). N = 4-tert-butylbenzaldehyde (Wohl-Ziegler bromination of M's benzylic methyl, then Sommelet with HMTA). O = trans-5,15-bis(4-tert-butylphenyl)porphyrinato zinc(II) (MacDonald 2+2 of N + dipyrromethane, DDQ oxidation, Zn(OAc)2 metallation; meso-10/20 retain H; Zn coordinated to all four porphyrin N). Q = 2,3,17,18-tetrabromo-O (NBS bromination of the four free beta-pyrrole positions of the two rings between the Ar-bearing meso edges). R = 3,17-diethynyl-2,18-dibromo porphyrinato Zn(II): double Sonogashira with (C6H13)3Si-CCH on Q replaces two of the four Br (the P6-axis pair) with THS-protected ethynyls, then n-Bu4NF deprotects to terminal alkynes; two Br remain as coupling sites for the final template-directed cyclooligomerisation. The template drawn in the scheme is hexakis[4-(pyridin-4-yl)phenyl]benzene (six pyridine N sites for the six Zn centres of the belt).
assumptions: Skeletal-drawing convention for implicit hydrogens (C valence 4, aromatic bond order 1.5) used to compute implicit-H counts.
Porphyrin-skeleton naming convention adopted in the model: meso carbons me5(A|B), me10(B|C), me15(C|D), me20(D|A); beta-carbons bX1/bX2; matches the P6 drawing.

For R, the identity of 'which two of the four Br are replaced by ethynyls' is fixed by the P6/belt figure (the pair on the oligomer axis); the IUPAC-style indices 3,17 vs 2,18 in answer.md are that choice.
Lean's logical axiom propext is allowed by the task statement ('standard Lean logical axioms are allowed'); no custom axioms were introduced.
source_gaps: The scheme does not give molecular formulas for M-R, so carbon counts in the Lean file are derived from the drawn connectivity (porphine core C20, two Ar groups C10 each, alkyne carbons C4 in R) rather than from printed formulas.

The (C6H13)3Si group (trihexylsilyl, THS) is treated as a protecting group removed by n-Bu4NF, per standard Sonogashira/TBAF chemistry; the problem does not spell out the deprotection product explicitly, but the two-step sequence and the final belt structure (no Si) determine it.
